title.zh-TW: 最多 $90 USD 迎新獎賞

text.zh-TW: 取自平台分享文案；實際內容與期限以 Crypto.com 官方公告為準。
text.en: Taken from the platform's share text; actual terms follow Crypto.com's official announcements.

intro.zh-TW: 透過 Crypto.com 交易可獲得迎新獎賞；也可以在註冊時輸入推薦碼。
intro.en: Trade with Crypto.com to earn a welcome reward, or enter the referral code when you sign up.

description.zh-TW: Crypto.com 是讓使用者交易加密資產的交易所平台。這個邀請連結的網址結尾就是邀請碼 xsud5ved2v；註冊時若畫面要求推薦碼，請自行填入這組代碼。平台分享文案提到最多 $90 USD 的迎新獎賞，實際內容與期限以 Crypto.com 官方公告為準。註冊前先確認網址列的網域與官方網站一致。
description.en:
Crypto.com is an exchange platform where users can trade crypto assets. The referral link on this page ends with the referral code xsud5ved2v, so the code is already part of it; if the sign-up screen asks for a referral code, enter it yourself exactly as shown.

The platform's share text mentions a welcome reward of up to $90 USD. Actual terms follow Crypto.com's official announcements. Before you enter personal details, confirm that the domain in the address bar matches Crypto.com's official website.
